title: High-efficiency ultra-thin CIGSe solar cells: defect engineering and back-surface field design
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30928-30948
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02870E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Serap Yiğit Gezgin, M. A. Basyooni-M. Kabatas, Hamdi Şükür Kiliç
High-efficiency ultra-thin CIGSe solar cells are numerically designed by tuning absorber doping, defect densities, band alignment, and Cu2O back-surface fields to suppress recombination and boost simulated efficiency to ∼40%.
